Small on purpose, small enough to finish in an afternoon. Step one, generate the world. Three rooms appear, the dusty library, the moonlit garden, the echo archives. Step two, enter the library. The room becomes your scene. Step three, generate the quest. Recover the rumored page, two options. Search the lower stacks or ask the archivist. Choose and the story resolves. Steps four and five, the caretaker comments on your quest, then you talk freely. Type anything, the sentiment route reads your tone and the caretaker answers in kind. And it really runs.
